decision: The hosted macOS runner cannot reliably activate the iOS confirmation sheet through Simulator host accessibility. Coordinate-based clicking is prohibited and was not used. The unreliable automation and CI-only native sentinel were removed. Existing parser tests remain fail-closed evidence, but application-level delivery and rejection remain unproven.
nextAcceptableEvidence: A semantic XCUITest/SpringBoard interaction or a physical-device/signed test environment that proves delivery with application PID, application log and unobscured rejection UI.
